text: This is a B1 text about hobbies. In modern society, hobbies plays a surprisingly significant role. Although some people might dismiss it as trivial, the impact of hobbies on our daily lives is undeniable. For instance, when we consider how much time and resources are devoted to hobbies, it becomes clear that it shapes our cultural landscape. Personally, I have found that engaging with hobbies has broadened my horizons and allowed me to connect with diverse groups of people.
